name: XGR
shortDescription: Native asset of XGRChain and the XETA EVM interchain hub.
description: XGR is the native asset of XGRChain, an EVM-compatible blockchain. XITA (XGR Interchain Token Alliance) supports permissionless route registration between XGRChain and supported EVM networks. A route is publicly usable only after verified source and destination deployments and authenticated message delivery; validators attest messages, not route admission.
